content.short: Cometh offers an advanced Web3 development platform for building Web3 games and DApps.
content.description: Cometh provides an advanced Web3 development platform designed for building Web3 games and DApps. With Cometh Connect, it streamlines onboarding by integrating biometrics and WebAuthn, making wallet access simpler and more intuitive. Wallets can be managed via biometrics, blending Web2 familiarity with Web3 innovation. The platform also includes the Cometh Marketplace, enabling NFT integration and delivering a modern, engaging marketplace experience for users.
